items.label: Physical dominance
items.text: Physical dominance: crowding, restraint, forced proximity, invasive touch, pain as leverage.

items.label: Social predation
items.text: Social predation: humiliation, exposure, weaponized witnesses, reputation destruction, isolation.

items.label: Coercive bargaining
items.text: Coercive bargaining: impossible choices, withheld necessities, conditional mercy, exploiting desperation.

items.label: Psychological warfare
items.text: Psychological warfare: gaslighting, boundary erosion, manufactured dependency, emotional hostage-taking.

items.label: Opportunistic violation
items.text: Opportunistic violation: exploiting compromised states, capitalizing on trust, breaching consent through force or coercion.

items.label: Environmental control
items.text: Environmental control: trapping, removing exits, destroying safety, contaminating comfort, sabotaging resources.

items.label: Institutional abuse
items.text: Institutional abuse: weaponizing authority, legal systems, hierarchies, or social structures.

items.label: Obsessive claiming
items.text: Obsessive claiming: possessive marking, surveillance, territorial invasion, forced intimacy, ownership behavior.
